model_annotation: The plot illustrates the training rewards over steps for different training policies. The x-axis, labeled “Steps,” is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500, with tick labels spaced every 50 steps. The y-axis, labeled “Training Rewards,” ranges from 0 to 0.4, with tick labels spaced every 0.05. A solid black line represents the “Llama-On-Policy-Easy” policy, which begins at approximately 0.0 and increases to a value of approximately 0.35 by 400 steps, exhibiting a generally steady upward trend. A red line represents the “Llama-LUFFY-Easy” policy, which starts at approximately 0.0 and rises to a value of approximately 0.25 by 400 steps, showing a similar upward trend to the black line. A pink shaded area represents the standard deviation of the “Llama-On-Policy-Easy” policy, fluctuating around the black line with a maximum value of approximately 0.03 at 100 steps and a minimum value of approximately 0.01 at 400 steps. The bottom plot shows the “Llama-On-Policy-Hard” and “Llama-LUFFY-Hard” policies, with a solid blue line representing the “Llama-On-Policy-Hard” policy, which begins at approximately 0.0 and increases to a value of approximately 0.1 by 400 steps, and a red line representing the “Llama-LUFFY-Hard” policy, which starts at approximately 0.0 and rises to a value of approximately 0.08 by 400 steps.
